author: packs
description: Healthcare clinics (X4-T1), outside the clinical record: patients (health data as a special category, masked), providers and locations, appointments, visits, referrals with stages and SLAs, insurance eligibility and pre-authorisation (NPHIES through a connector), care programmes and patient complaints. The medical record stays in the HIS or EMR, linked by id. Roles, report queries and a sidebar.
name: healthcare

definition.description: Moves referrals through their stages within SLA.
definition.name: Referral Coordinator

definition.description: Reads every clinic record and runs care programmes.
definition.name: Clinic Manager
Healthcare: Appointments by Status This Week
definition.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS appointments FROM hc_appointment WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND starts_at >= date_trunc('week', NOW()) AND starts_at < date_trunc('week', NOW()) + INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

target.query: Healthcare: Appointments by Status This Week

definition.name: Healthcare: Referrals Past Due
definition.sql: SELECT id, reference, specialty, urgency, due_by, status FROM hc_referral WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND status IN ('received', 'triage', 'accepted') AND due_by < NOW() ORDER BY due_by

definition.name: Healthcare: Pending Pre-authorisations
definition.sql: SELECT id, reference, insurer, estimated_amount, submitted_at FROM hc_preauthorisation WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND status IN ('draft', 'eligibility_checked', 'submitted') ORDER BY submitted_at
